recipes.name: Margarita
recipes.description: The perfect balance of agave, citrus, and orange liqueur — the world's favorite tequila cocktail.
instructions: Rub a lime wedge around half the rim of a rocks glass and dip it in salt.
Shake tequila, lime juice, and triple sec hard with ice.
Strain into the glass over fresh ice and garnish with a lime wheel.

recipes.name: Tommy's Margarita
recipes.description: A modern San Francisco classic: the Margarita stripped to tequila, lime, and agave.
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice and garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Paloma
recipes.description: Mexico's everyday favorite — brighter and more refreshing than a Margarita.
instructions: Build tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice, and syrup in a salt-rimmed highball over ice.
Stir briefly, top with soda water, and garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

recipes.name: Tequila Sunrise
recipes.description: A 70s icon — orange juice and tequila with a grenadine sunrise sinking to the bottom.
instructions: Build tequila and orange juice in a highball over ice and stir.
Slowly pour grenadine down the inside of the glass so it settles at the bottom.
Garnish with an orange slice and a cherry.

recipes.name: Oaxaca Old Fashioned
recipes.description: Death & Co's agave-powered spin on the Old Fashioned — tequila and smoky mezcal.
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled.
Strain over a large cube in a rocks glass and garnish with a flamed orange peel.

recipes.name: Naked & Famous
recipes.description: A smoky, bittersweet modern classic in perfect equal parts (traditionally with yellow Chartreuse — green works with a lighter hand).
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

recipes.name: Daiquiri
recipes.description: Rum, lime, and sugar — the drink bartenders order to judge other bartenders.
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice until frosty.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lime wheel.

recipes.name: Strawberry Daiquiri
recipes.description: The classic Daiquiri with fresh strawberries shaken right in — no blender required.
instructions: Muddle the strawberries with the syrup in a shaker.
Add rum, lime juice, and ice; shake hard.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a strawberry.

recipes.name: Mojito
recipes.description: Cuba's minty, effervescent classic — summer in a glass.
instructions: Gently press the mint leaves with the syrup in the bottom of a highball.
Add rum, lime juice, and crushed ice; stir until the glass frosts.
Top with soda water and garnish with a fat mint sprig.

recipes.name: Piña Colada
recipes.description: Puerto Rico's creamy pineapple-coconut escape hatch.
instructions: Shake everything very hard with ice (or blend with a cup of ice).
Pour into a tall glass and garnish with pineapple and a cherry.

recipes.name: Mai Tai
recipes.description: Trader Vic's tiki masterpiece — rum, lime, orange, and almond.
instructions: Shake white rum, triple sec, orgeat, and lime juice with crushed ice.
Pour unstrained into a rocks glass and float the dark rum on top.
Garnish with mint and a spent lime shell.

recipes.name: Dark 'n' Stormy
recipes.description: Bermuda's national drink: dark rum thunderheads over a spicy ginger sea.
instructions: Fill a highball with ice and add lime juice and ginger beer.
Float the dark rum on top and garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Cuba Libre
recipes.description: A rum and coke that earned its name — the lime makes all the difference.
instructions: Build rum and lime juice in a highball over ice.
Top with cola, stir once, and garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Caipirinha
recipes.description: Brazil's national cocktail — muddled lime and sugar with grassy cachaça.
instructions: Muddle the lime wedges with the sugar in a sturdy rocks glass.
Fill with crushed ice, add cachaça, and stir well.

recipes.name: Planter's Punch
recipes.description: An old Caribbean formula: one of sour, two of sweet, three of strong, four of weak.
instructions: Shake everything with ice.
Pour over fresh ice in a tall glass and garnish with whatever fruit is nearby.

recipes.name: Old Fashioned
recipes.description: The original cocktail: spirit, sugar, bitters, and nothing to hide behind.
instructions: Stir bourbon, syrup, and bitters with ice until well chilled.
Strain over a large cube in a rocks glass.
Express an orange peel over the top and drop it in.

recipes.name: Manhattan
recipes.description: Rye and sweet vermouth in perfect proportion — the king of stirred cocktails.
instructions: Stir everything with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a cocktail cherry.

recipes.name: Whiskey Sour
recipes.description: Bourbon, lemon, and sugar — add the egg white for a silky classic texture.
instructions: If using egg white, shake everything without ice first.
Add ice and shake hard, then strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
Dot bitters on the foam if you like.

recipes.name: Boulevardier
recipes.description: A Negroni that traded gin for bourbon and put on a winter coat.
instructions: Stir everything with ice until well chilled.
Strain over a large cube and garnish with an orange peel.

recipes.name: Mint Julep
recipes.description: Kentucky's frosted-cup classic — bourbon over a mountain of crushed ice.
instructions: Gently press the mint with the syrup in the bottom of the cup.
Pack with crushed ice, add bourbon, and stir until the cup frosts.
Crown with more crushed ice and a big bouquet of mint.

recipes.name: Whiskey Highball
recipes.description: Two ingredients, endlessly refreshing — treat it with Japanese precision.
instructions: Fill a chilled highball with ice and add the whiskey.
Top gently with cold soda water and stir once.

recipes.name: Gold Rush
recipes.description: A modern New York classic — a Whiskey Sour that struck honey.
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice.
Strain over a large cube in a rocks glass.

recipes.name: Penicillin
recipes.description: Sam Ross's modern legend: scotch, lemon, honey, and ginger — doctor's orders.
instructions: Muddle the ginger in a shaker, then add scotch, lemon, and honey syrup.
Shake hard with ice and double-strain over a large cube.
If you have a smoky Islay scotch, float a quarter ounce on top.

recipes.name: Sazerac
recipes.description: New Orleans in a glass: rye, Peychaud's, and an absinthe-perfumed chill.
instructions: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and dump the excess.
Stir rye, syrup, and bitters with ice, then strain into the glass (no ice).
Express a lemon peel over the top — tradition says don't drop it in.

recipes.name: Hot Toddy
recipes.description: Whiskey, honey, and lemon in hot water — comfort you can sip.
instructions: Warm a mug with hot water and empty it.
Add whiskey, honey, and lemon, then top with 4 oz hot water.
Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel studded with cloves.

recipes.name: Irish Coffee
recipes.description: Hot coffee, Irish whiskey, and a cool cream cap — the world's best dessert drink.
instructions: Combine whiskey, hot coffee, and syrup in a warmed glass mug.
Float lightly whipped cream on top by pouring over the back of a spoon.
Drink the coffee through the cream — don't stir.

recipes.name: Amaretto Sour
recipes.description: Almond liqueur with lemon and a bourbon backbone — far better than its reputation.
instructions: If using egg white, shake everything without ice first.
Add ice, shake hard, and strain over fresh ice.
Garnish with a lemon peel and a cherry.

recipes.name: Negroni
recipes.description: Equal parts gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth — bitter, bracing, perfect.
instructions: Stir everything with ice until well chilled.
Strain over a large cube and garnish with an orange peel.

recipes.name: Americano
recipes.description: The Negroni's lighter ancestor — Campari and vermouth lengthened with soda.
instructions: Build Campari and vermouth in a highball over ice.
Top with soda water and garnish with an orange slice.

recipes.name: Aperol Spritz
recipes.description: The orange sunset of Italian aperitivo hour.
instructions: Fill a big wine glass with ice.
Add prosecco first, then Aperol, then a splash of soda.
Garnish with an orange slice.

recipes.name: Gin & Tonic
recipes.description: The two-ingredient classic that rewards good tonic and lots of ice.
instructions: Fill the glass to the top with ice.
Add gin, top with tonic, and stir once.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Tom Collins
recipes.description: Sparkling gin lemonade for grown-ups.
instructions: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled collins glass and top with soda.
Garnish with a lemon wheel and a cherry.

recipes.name: Gimlet
recipes.description: Gin and lime, crisp and cold — Raymond Chandler approved.
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lime wheel.

recipes.name: Martini
recipes.description: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred silky — the definition of a cocktail.
instructions: Stir gin and vermouth with plenty of ice until ice cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist or olives.

recipes.name: Vodka Martini
recipes.description: The Martini's cleaner, colder sibling.
instructions: Stir vodka and vermouth with plenty of ice until ice cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with a twist or olives.

recipes.name: French 75
recipes.description: Gin and lemon with a champagne charge — named after an artillery piece for a reason.
instructions: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice.
Strain into a flute and top with sparkling wine.
Garnish with a long lemon twist.

recipes.name: Bramble
recipes.description: Dick Bradsell's London classic — a gin sour under a blackberry cascade.
instructions: Shake gin, lemon juice, and syrup with ice; strain over crushed ice.
Drizzle the crème de mûre over the top so it bleeds down.
Garnish with a blackberry and a lemon slice.

recipes.name: Bee's Knees
recipes.description: A Prohibition-era gin sour sweetened with honey — 'the bee's knees' meant 'the best'.
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

recipes.name: Southside
recipes.description: A gin sour gone minty — the Mojito's city cousin.
instructions: Shake everything hard with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a mint leaf.

recipes.name: Clover Club
recipes.description: A pre-Prohibition beauty: gin, lemon, raspberry-red syrup, and silky egg white.
instructions: Shake everything without ice to build the foam.
Add ice, shake hard, and double-strain into a chilled coupe.

recipes.name: Last Word
recipes.description: Four equal parts, one unforgettable drink — a Detroit relic revived into a modern staple.
instructions: Shake everything with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

recipes.name: Martinez
recipes.description: The missing link between the Manhattan and the Martini.
instructions: Stir everything with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

recipes.name: Aviation
recipes.description: Gin, lemon, and maraschino in a pale sky-colored sour (add crème de violette if you ever find it).
instructions: Shake everything with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a cherry.

recipes.name: Hugo Spritz
recipes.description: The alpine spritz — elderflower, prosecco, and mint.
instructions: Fill a big wine glass with ice and slap the mint sprig into it.
Add elderflower liqueur, top with prosecco and soda, and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime slice if you have one.

recipes.name: Moscow Mule
recipes.description: The vodka drink that launched a thousand copper mugs.
instructions: Build vodka and lime juice in an ice-filled mug.
Top with ginger beer, stir once, and garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Cosmopolitan
recipes.description: The blush-pink 90s icon that's secretly a well-built sour.
instructions: Shake everything with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with an orange twist.

recipes.name: Espresso Martini
recipes.description: Wake me up, then... — vodka, coffee liqueur, and a fresh shot of espresso.
instructions: Shake everything very hard with ice to build the crema.
Double-strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with three coffee beans.

recipes.name: White Russian
recipes.description: Vodka, coffee liqueur, and cream — the Dude abides.
instructions: Build vodka and coffee liqueur in a rocks glass over ice.
Float the cream on top and stir lazily.

recipes.name: Black Russian
recipes.description: The White Russian minus the cream — dark, sweet, and simple.
instructions: Build both ingredients in a rocks glass over ice.
Stir well.

recipes.name: Bloody Mary
recipes.description: Brunch's savory centerpiece — season it like you mean it.
instructions: Combine vodka, tomato juice, and lemon juice with ice and season with salt, pepper, and hot sauce to taste.
Roll between two mixing glasses (don't shake) to combine.
Pour into an ice-filled highball and garnish with celery and a lemon wedge.

recipes.name: Screwdriver
recipes.description: Vodka and orange juice — allegedly stirred with an actual screwdriver by oil workers.
instructions: Build in an ice-filled highball and stir.
Garnish with an orange slice.

recipes.name: Sea Breeze
recipes.description: Cranberry and grapefruit keep this vodka cooler tart and quenching.
instructions: Build in an ice-filled highball and stir.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Cape Codder
recipes.description: Vodka-cranberry, done properly with a squeeze of lime.
instructions: Build in an ice-filled highball and stir.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Greyhound
recipes.description: Vodka and grapefruit — tart, dry, and dangerously drinkable.
instructions: Build in an ice-filled highball and stir.
Salt the rim first and it becomes a Salty Dog.

recipes.name: Kamikaze
recipes.description: A vodka-lime-triple sec sour with an 80s attitude.
instructions: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lime wheel.

recipes.name: Lemon Drop
recipes.description: A sugar-rimmed vodka sour that tastes like grown-up lemon candy.
instructions: Rim a chilled martini glass with sugar.
Shake everything with ice and double-strain into the glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

recipes.name: Vodka Tonic
recipes.description: Clean, cold, and quinine-crisp.
instructions: Fill a highball with ice, add vodka, and top with tonic.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Sidecar
recipes.description: Cognac's greatest cocktail — bright, elegant, and quietly strong.
instructions: Optionally rim half of a chilled coupe with sugar.
Shake everything with ice and double-strain into the glass.
Garnish with an orange twist.

recipes.name: Mimosa
recipes.description: Equal parts bubbles and orange juice — brunch's official beverage.
instructions: Pour chilled sparkling wine into a flute.
Top gently with cold orange juice — no stirring needed.

recipes.name: Bellini
recipes.description: Venice's peach-and-prosecco classic, invented at Harry's Bar.
instructions: Purée ripe peaches and chill.
Pour the purée into a flute and slowly top with prosecco, stirring gently.

recipes.name: Kahlúa Old Fashioned
recipes.description: An after-dinner Old Fashioned where coffee liqueur plays the sugar.
instructions: Stir everything with ice until well chilled.
Strain over a large cube and garnish with an orange peel.

recipes.name: Mudslide
recipes.description: Vodka, coffee liqueur, and Irish cream — dessert with a kick.
instructions: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice (or blend with ice cream, no judgment).

recipes.name: Elderflower Gin Sour
recipes.description: A floral twist on the gin sour with St-Germain doing the sweet talking.
instructions: If using egg white, shake everything without ice first.
Add ice, shake hard, and double-strain into a chilled coupe.
